sentences.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
sentences.zh: 我父母老是为一些小事争吵。真是烦死人了!

sentences.en: The homeless people were annoyed by the flies and mosquitoes.
sentences.zh: 无家可归的人被苍蝇和蚊子骚扰。

sentences.en: The sound was annoying but harmless to the human body.
sentences.zh: 声音很烦人，但对人体无害。
